findings.title: Transport
findings.summary: No transport at school times from the affected habitations; the walk is long and steep for young children.

evidence.label: Walk 4.6 km, about 82 min for a young child
evidence.detail: Tobler's hiking function on the route profile, child pace × 0.75; 108 m up, 238 m down

evidence.label: Road 3.8 km, about 19 min by vehicle
evidence.detail: Road route along the Pekhri link road and the valley road

evidence.label: Actual transport availability
evidence.detail: HRTC Banjar–Gushaini departs 07:10, 13:40, 16:50 — none in the school-time window; timetable not verified

findings.title: Seasonal access
findings.summary: The footpath crosses the Tirthan at Baridropa–Jawal footbridge, which floods in the monsoon.

evidence.label: 19 citizen responses mention seasonal access
evidence.detail: 4 of them checked against a field observation

evidence.label: Walking route crosses Baridropa–Jawal footbridge
evidence.detail: Pedestrian bridge damaged in 2023 floods; temporary wooden bridges washed away, including on 13 Aug 2025; villagers rebuilt it a third time. Season: Monsoon (Jul–Sep)

evidence.label: Field evidence: seasonal bridge issue
evidence.detail: Footbridge at Baridropa–Jawal washed away on 13 Aug 2025; villagers rebuilt a wooden bridge. Not safe in heavy rain. (JE, PWD Banjar (reported in The Tribune), 2025-08-20)

findings.title: Route safety for young children
findings.summary: Steep path and a river crossing; parents worry about girls walking alone.

evidence.label: 15 of 27 affected students are girls; 1 with a disability

findings.title: Receiving-school capacity
findings.summary: GPS Gushaini has 40 free seats for 27 students.

findings.title: Building condition at GPS Pekhri-2
findings.summary: The current building is unsafe. Rebuilding is an alternative to merging.

evidence.label: Pekhri-2 school building in poor condition; needs demolition and replacement.

gaps: Actual travel time in school hours
